body.html:
Jhansi (UP) – A fierce scuffle between a head constable and a youth in the Gumnawara area under Nawabad police station limits has gone viral on social media. The incident, caught on CCTV, shows punches and kicks exchanged during a 15-minute brawl.

The fight broke out when Head Constable Shailendra Singh, posted with UP-112 in Lalitpur, was returning to his residence. Allegedly under the influence of alcohol, Gajendra Singh Sengar confronted the officer with abusive language, sparking a violent altercation.

Though no formal complaint has been lodged by either party, the local police have taken preventive action and produced the accused in court. Authorities confirmed that the situation is now under control.

articles.title: BREAKING: Man who molested girl student in Bareilly caught, shot in leg by UP Police
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bareilly, UP - A man who molested a coaching student in broad daylight has been arrested after police shot him in the leg during an encounter.

body.html:
Bareilly, UP - A man who molested a coaching student in broad daylight has been arrested after police shot him in the leg during an encounter.

The incident occurred on June 21 when Musbbir, son of Mohammad Rais from Math Kamal Nayanpur, groped a girl student going to coaching in Gandhipuram around 3:30 PM. The entire assault was captured on nearby CCTV cameras.

Based on the victim's family complaint, FIR 584/2025 was registered at Izzatnagar police station under IPC sections 78/352/351(3) and POCSO Act sections 7/8.

During a police encounter on June 22 at 10:30 PM near Kashmiri Kothi garden in Karmachari Nagar, accused Musbbir was shot in the right leg in self-defence firing. He has been hospitalised and legal proceedings are underway.

The swift action came after clear CCTV evidence identified the bike-riding molester.

articles.title: Passenger Thrashed on Vande Bharat for Refusing Seat to BJP MLA Rajeev Singh

articles.excerpt: Jhansi/New Delhi – A passenger on the New Delhi–Bhopal Vande Bharat Express was allegedly beaten up on June 19 after he refused to exchange seats with BJP MLA Rajeev Singh from Babina, Jhansi. CCTV footage, now viral, shows a group attacking the man near the coach’s automated door.

body.html:
Jhansi/New Delhi – A passenger on the New Delhi–Bhopal Vande Bharat Express was allegedly beaten up on June 19 after he refused to exchange seats with BJP MLA Rajeev Singh from Babina, Jhansi.

CCTV footage, now viral, shows a group attacking the man near the coach’s automated door. The altercation reportedly began when the MLA or his aides asked the man to vacate his seat. When he refused, the situation escalated, culminating in an assault at Jhansi station.

MLA Singh later filed a non-cognizable report (NCR) accusing the co-passenger of misbehaving with his family. GRP said the clash started over a seat and an objectionable posture. No formal complaint has been lodged yet by the assaulted passenger, though police said further action will follow upon receiving it.

articles.title: Yadav Storyteller Beaten, Head Shaved for Reciting Bhagwat in Brahmin Village
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Etawah (UP) – In a disturbing caste-based attack, storyteller Mani Singh Yadav was humiliated and assaulted while reciting Bhagwat Katha in Nagla Nandi village. The accused shaved his head, rubbed his nose on a woman’s foot, and broke his harmonium.

body.html:
Etawah (UP) – In a disturbing caste-based attack, storyteller Mani Singh Yadav was humiliated and assaulted while reciting Bhagwat Katha in Nagla Nandi village. The accused shaved his head, rubbed his nose on a woman’s foot, and broke his harmonium.

Mani alleged the organisers asked his caste on Day 1 of the event (scheduled 21–27 June). When he revealed he was a Yadav, he was called a Dalit and told, “How dare you do Bhagwat in a Brahmin village?” He was then beaten and insulted.

Police have filed an FIR against Atul, Manish, Pappu, and 50 unidentified persons. Investigations are ongoing.

articles.title: Miraculous Escape Caught on Camera: Gas Cylinder Blast Narrowly Misses Woman and Man
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Date/Time of Incident: Wednesday, June 18, Around 3 PM In a heart-stopping video now going viral on social media, a woman and a man narrowly escaped a massive fire triggered by an LPG gas leak and explosion inside a house.

body.html:
Date/Time of Incident: Wednesday, June 18, Around 3 PM

In a heart-stopping video now going viral on social media, a woman and a man narrowly escaped a massive fire triggered by an LPG gas leak and explosion inside a house. The dramatic incident, captured on CCTV footage, is reported to have occurred around 3 PM on Wednesday, June 18, though the exact location remains unknown.

The video shows a red LPG cylinder leaking gas heavily, with a woman desperately trying to stop it. Failing to control the leak, she rushes out to seek help and returns moments later with a man. The two approach the cylinder from different entrances to shut the gas valve. Just as they try to fix it, a powerful blast erupts from the stove, setting the entire room ablaze.

The woman had the presence of mind to keep the windows and doors open, reducing gas buildup. This ventilation reduced the blast impact, allowing both individuals to escape unharmed, seconds after the explosion.

The video captures the terrifying moment when the kitchen erupts in flames, with both people seen running for their lives as the fire spreads rapidly.

Social media users hailed the woman’s quick thinking and bravery, crediting her actions for preventing a potentially deadly accident. No injuries or fatalities were reported.

No casualties due to open ventilation and swift escape

articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Jalaun (UP): A 35-year-old woman, Aamna, was brutally assaulted and thrown off the roof by her husband Arif and in-laws in Tilak Nagar, Orai, over a demand for ₹10 lakh dowry. The shocking incident, caught on video, shows the woman being chased, beaten, and pushed off the terrace.

body.html:
Jalaun (UP): A 35-year-old woman, Aamna, was brutally assaulted and thrown off the roof by her husband Arif and in-laws in Tilak Nagar, Orai, over a demand for ₹10 lakh dowry. The shocking incident, caught on video, shows the woman being chased, beaten, and pushed off the terrace. She landed on a parked bike and sustained serious injuries.

Aamna's 10-year-old son Affan witnessed the assault and informed his maternal grandfather. She was rushed to the district hospital and remains critical.

The woman's father alleged that Arif, her third husband, had been harassing her since marriage and had thrown two of her children from a previous marriage out of the house. Aamna named seven in-laws in her complaint, including her sister-in-law and stepdaughter. All accused are absconding.

Police have registered an FIR and launched a manhunt.

articles.title: PGI Doctor Caught Beating Adopted Daughter, Wife Watches Silently in Shimla
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Shimla (Himachal Pradesh) – A disturbing video has surfaced from Shimla showing a senior doctor from PGIMER mercilessly beating his 13-year-old adopted daughter with a wooden stick, while his wife, also a PGI professor, watches silently.

body.html:
Shimla (Himachal Pradesh) – A disturbing video has surfaced from Shimla showing a senior doctor from PGIMER mercilessly beating his 13-year-old adopted daughter with a wooden stick, while his wife, also a PGI professor, watches silently.

The video, reportedly sent by a concerned neighbour, shows the terrified girl running around the room trying to save herself, but the father continues to thrash her. The neighbour, who also tried to intervene, alleged that this abuse has been going on for nearly a decade.

The Chandigarh Child Commission (CCPCR) has taken suo motu cognizance and sought a detailed report within 7 days from Himachal Police and the Child Welfare Committee. The PGI administration has also filed a complaint and asked the couple for an explanation.

The girl’s safety is now the top concern, and rescue efforts are underway via the District Child Protection Unit and Child Helpline.

articles.title: Dowry Horror in Gaya: Woman Found Dead, Assault Video of Husband Surfaces – Family Alleges Murder
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Gaya (Bihar) – A suspicious death of a woman, Nisha Kumari, in Janakpur Manpur area has sparked outrage, with her family alleging dowry murder.

body.html:
Gaya (Bihar) – A suspicious death of a woman, Nisha Kumari, in Janakpur Manpur area has sparked outrage, with her family alleging dowry murder.

Two videos have emerged — one showing injury marks on her dead body, and another from two months ago where husband Abhishek Kumar is seen brutally beating her in front of their daughters.

Nisha's father, Shravan Prasad, has filed an FIR, accusing the in-laws of murder for dowry. He claims his daughter was harassed after the birth of two daughters and as his sons got high-paying jobs.

Shravan said he received a call at 3 AM claiming Nisha had consumed poison, but found her dead with visible marks of assault. He also dismissed a so-called suicide note as forged, not in Nisha’s handwriting.

Abhishek claims he was in Patna at the time. However, police confirmed the in-laws did not inform them of the incident. FIR has been lodged and investigation is underway.

articles.title: CCTV Horror in Pune: Fired Housekeeper Stabs Security Guard, Smashes Head with Brick in Chinchwad
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Pune – A shocking act of violence was caught on CCTV at Shantiban Society, Chinchwadgaon, where former housekeeping staff Ram Londhe brutally attacked security guard Sudam Kamithe.

body.html:
Pune – A shocking act of violence was caught on CCTV at Shantiban Society, Chinchwadgaon, where former housekeeping staff Ram Londhe brutally attacked security guard Sudam Kamithe.

The incident took place when Londhe, reportedly angry over being sacked due to substance abuse, tried to forcefully enter the society. When Kamithe stopped him, Londhe suddenly pulled out a knife and stabbed him in the abdomen. He then snatched a cement block and smashed it on Kamithe’s head, leaving him critically injured.

Despite being wounded, Kamithe attempted to fight back. The entire assault was recorded on CCTV and has gone viral, sparking outrage across social media.

Londhe was arrested within hours of the incident. Kamithe is currently undergoing treatment. Police suspect revenge as the motive and further investigation is underway.
